title: There is definitely a flaw in the design
text: There is definitely a flaw in the design. Used to create a beverage station of sorts, but I could not use the top part because of a flaw in the design of the unit. The top part has to attach flush to the back of the base, but the top of the base has a lip and isn’t flush against the legs, which means the top can’t fit where it needs to. It worked better for me without it, though, so I kept it.
